Alan Hansen's Sports Challenge.name: Alan Hansen's Sports Challenge
Alan Hansen's Sports Challenge.summary: Alan Hansen's Sports Challenge is a trivia game created by Oxygen Interactive.

Bratz - The Movie.name: Bratz: The Movie
Bratz - The Movie.summary: It's time for the Bratz girls to hit the red carpet! Join Chloe, Jade, Sasha and Yasmin as they rock out in explosive music shows, strut the fashion runway with stylin' outfits designed by you, and publish the hottest magazine ever! Their hard work lands them a once in a lifetime opportunity to star in their very own movie!

Circus.name: Circus
Circus.summary: Circus is an Action game, developed and published by 505 Games, which was released in Europe in 2010.

Cooking Mama - World Kitchen.name: Cooking Mama: World Kitchen
Cooking Mama - World Kitchen.summary: The goal of the game is to complete a meal of the player's choice. The player cooks in steps, for example, if making sushi, the player will cut the fish in one step, and do the rice in another. Every time a meal is finished, other meals are unlocked, and so are other characters, family and friends.

London Taxi - Rushour.name: London Taxi: Rushour
London Taxi - Rushour.summary: Collect customers and take them to famous London destinations within the time limit in order to get paid.

Lost in Shadow.name: Lost in Shadow
Lost in Shadow.summary:
"Lost in Shadow" (released as "A Shadow's Tale" in Europe/Australia and as "Kage no Tou" in Japan) is a puzzle platforming video game developed for Nintendo's Wii console by Hudson Soft. It was released in Japan in July 2010, in Australia and Europe in October 2010, and in North America in January 2011. It was also released for Wii U via Nintendo eShop in 2016.

Lost in Shadow is played largely in the background of the game environment as the player controls a boy's shadow, which must climb the shadows of a tall tower, rife with puzzles and enemies. He is accompanied by a sylph that can alter the direction of the foreground light sources, altering the alignment of shadows upon which he climbs. There are times in the game when the boy is able to materialize into the three-dimensional world and briefly interact with the objects themselves as opposed to simply their shadows.

Namco Museum Remix.name: Namco Museum Remix
Namco Museum Remix.summary:
Namco Museum Remix is a video game compilation for the Wii, featuring a wide array of classic and updated Namco arcade games. Featured in the compilation are the original versions of nine arcade games from the 1970s and 1980s.

Includes Cutie Q, Galaxian, Dig Dug, Super Pac-Man, Xevious, Mappy, Pac & Pal, Gaplus and Pac-Mania, as well as five remade "remix" versions of Rally-X, Galaga, Motos, Gator Panic and Pac 'n Roll.

Super Robot Taisen Neo.name: Super Robot Taisen Neo
Super Robot Taisen Neo.summary: Super Robot Taisen NEO is a Super Robot Wars video game that was released on the Nintendo Wii console on 29 October 2009. Neo was developed by Banpresto and published in Japan by Namcot Bandai Games.
